scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/bundle-main.mjs && node scripts/copy-renderer.mjs
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @pideck/web build && pnpm run build && electron .
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @pideck/web build && pnpm run build && electron-forge package
scripts.make: pnpm --filter @pideck/web build && pnpm run build && pnpm run make:dist
